records.title: Bias-Aware Low-Rank Adaptation: Mitigating Catastrophic Inheritance of Large Language Models
records.reason: BA-LoRA decomposes LoRA's catastrophic inheritance of pre-training bias into knowledge drift, representation collapse and overfitting, and mitigates it during parameter-efficient fine-tuning; it is about fine-tuning quality/fairness, with no inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Efficient transformer with reinforced position embedding for language models
records.reason: Concatenates reinforced positional embeddings with token embeddings and reuses the normalized embedding matrix as attention values in a small encoder-decoder Transformer, improving training/validation loss and epoch time on Portuguese-English translation; the efficiency measured is training time for a translation model, not LLM inference.

records.title: K-MSHC: Unmasking Minimally Sufficient Head Circuits in Large Language Models with Experiments on Syntactic Classification Tasks
records.reason: K-MSHC identifies minimally sufficient attention-head circuits in Gemma-9B for grammar acceptability and arithmetic tasks and analyzes cross-task head overlap; it is mechanistic interpretability of model internals, with no inference acceleration, compression, or serving mechanism.

records.title: LLMs for LLMs: A Structured Prompting Methodology for Long Legal Documents
records.reason: Applies structured prompting with document chunking/augmentation and distribution-based candidate selection heuristics to Qwen-2 for information retrieval over long CUAD legal contracts; a legal-domain prompting application, not an inference system.

records.title: Hybrid Quantum-Classical Recurrent Neural Networks
records.reason: QRNN realizes the recurrent core as a parametrized quantum circuit whose unitary hidden state is read out via mid-circuit Pauli expectations, evaluated in simulation on sentiment, MNIST and translation; a quantum model architecture study with no LLM inference-system relevance.

records.title: Automated Code Generation Algorithm Using GPT-Based Language Models for Secure Software Development
records.reason: Presents a GPT-based automated code-generation algorithm combining prompt engineering, reinforcement learning and fine-tuning on programming datasets, plus a code validation module for secure software development; an application of LLMs to coding, not an inference system.

records.title: Enhancing Abstraction in Large Language Models Through Nature-Inspired Semantic Patterns
records.reason: Proposes enhancing LLM abstraction by mapping a fourfold nature-inspired semantic pattern (Kn/Po/Pr/H) onto language structure to improve theme recognition and implicit inference; a conceptual NLP proposal with no inference, serving, or efficiency mechanism.

records.title: Hierarchical Multi-Modal Transformer for Cross-Modal Long Document Classification
records.reason: HMT fuses text and image features hierarchically with a dynamic mask transfer module for cross-modal long document classification on newly built datasets; a multimodal classification model, not an inference or serving contribution.

records.title: Let your LLM generate a few tokens and you will reduce the need for retrieval
records.reason: Distills an LLM-as-judge into an IK (I Know) classifier that decides whether a RAG query needs retrieval, cutting search/reranking steps by over 50% at 80% accuracy; it is a RAG gating classifier trained by distillation, not an inference-system technique.

records.title: Supernova: Achieving More with Less in Transformer Architectures
records.reason: Supernova is a 650M decoder-only model combining RoPE, 3:1 GQA and a custom 128k BPE tokenizer to reach 90% of 1B-model performance with 35% fewer parameters and 100B training tokens; GQA/tokenizer choices are inference-relevant, but the paper reports model quality versus training budget, not inference latency or serving behavior.

records.title: LieTransformer: Equivariant self-attention for Lie Groups
records.reason: LieTransformer builds Lie-group-equivariant self-attention layers and evaluates on point-cloud shape counting, molecular property regression and Hamiltonian particle trajectories; a geometric deep-learning architecture for science applications, unrelated to LLM inference.

records.title: SWE-Master: Unleashing the Potential of Software Engineering Agents via Post-Training
records.reason: SWE-Master is a reproducible post-training framework (trajectory synthesis, long-horizon SFT, RL with execution feedback) that raises Qwen2.5-Coder-32B to 61.4% on SWE-bench Verified; despite mentioning inference framework design, the contribution is agent post-training, not inference systems.

records.title: Structured Episodic Event Memory
records.reason: SEEM organizes LLM-agent long-term memory into graph relational facts plus episodic event frames with reverse provenance expansion, improving LoCoMo/LongMemEval narrative coherence; it is an agent memory/retrieval framework, not the model's inference memory or serving stack.

records.title: RouteMoA: Dynamic Routing without Pre-Inference Boosts Efficient Mixture-of-Agents
records.reason: RouteMoA routes queries in a Mixture-of-Agents pool with a lightweight scorer that screens candidate models before any inference and a judge mixture that corrects scores, cutting MoA cost by 89.8% and latency by 63.6% in large pools; it is inference-time model routing at the agent-framework level rather than a serving system for a model.

records.title: D2Pruner: Debiased Importance and Structural Diversity for MLLM Token Pruning
records.reason: D2Pruner prunes visual tokens in MLLMs by combining a debiased attention-based importance score with maximal-independent-set selection over a spatial-semantic hybrid graph, reducing LLaVA-1.5-7B FLOPs by 74.2% while retaining 99.2% performance and sustaining 85.7% at 90% token reduction on InternVL localization; a direct inference-acceleration technique for multimodal LLMs.

records.title: HGMEM: Hypergraph-based Working Memory to Improve Multi-step RAG for Long-Context Complex Relational Modeling
records.reason: HGMEM represents RAG working memory as a hypergraph whose hyperedges link facts and thoughts for multi-step relational reasoning over long contexts; it targets reasoning quality in retrieval pipelines, not inference efficiency or serving.

records.title: InfoSeeker: A Scalable Hierarchical Parallel Agent Framework for Web Information Seeking
records.reason: InfoSeeker organizes web information-seeking agents into Host/Manager/parallel Worker layers with context isolation, reporting 3-5x task-execution speedup on WideSearch/BrowseComp; the parallelism is agent workflow orchestration, not model inference.

records.title: SearchArt: Training Long-Horizon Search Agent with Scalable Synthetic and Verified Task
records.reason: SearchArt synthesizes verified long-horizon search tasks and trajectories from web documents and evidence graphs, then trains search agents with SFT plus RL; a training-data and post-training framework for agents, not inference.

records.title: FLAME: Flow Enhanced Legendre Memory Models for General Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: FLAME is a lightweight time-series foundation model family using translated/scaled Legendre memory and a normalizing-flow forecasting head, benchmarked on TSFM-Bench/ProbTS/TFB; a forecasting application model unrelated to LLM inference systems.

records.title: Cut Less, Fold More: Model Compression through the Lens of Projection Geometry
records.reason: Formalizes structured pruning as axis-aligned projection and model folding as low-rank projection via weight clustering, proving folding's smaller reconstruction error within rank distance one and validating on 1000+ checkpoints of ResNet/ViT/CLIP plus small 60M/130M LLaMA models; compression theory relevant to inference, but LLM evidence is limited to tiny models and no latency is measured.
